acceptance: A green main closes the stop and the landings resume
fix: Poll the required CI of origin/main from the loop tick at a policy interval (reuse mainCIRedForSHA). On red: emit GATE_REPO_MAIN_CI_RED (INCIDENT) with the failed job names, and open the main-red stop without a lane reproduction. On green: close it. A ship precheck refuses a landing while the stop is open, with a typed cause.
